title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：petrol　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 petrol 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the driver ① saved the petrol that no passenger in the station would have measured, and he said the saving was the whole of the day. The ② petrol, meaning the fuel itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book; petrol, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of petrol in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ petrol at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Petrol, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the driver said the measuring is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the petrol was the whole of the matter, meaning the cost and not the fuel. The ⑥ petrol, meaning the cost and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; petrol, he said, is either something you save or the only word that means both fuel and a cost. He said the cost is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ petrol had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ petrol of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of measuring; petrol, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ petrol I remember is the petrol measured in the timetable, which closed in 1979 and is still measured as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Petrol, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all petrol, she said, is a cost that has agreed to look like fuel. She said the cost was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 汽油（指车站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 汽油（指那升汽油本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：save the petrol 省这一升汽油
D. n. 汽油（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 汽油之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的汽油之事）
F. n. 汽油（指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一升）
G. n. 汽油、开销（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 开销（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saved the petrol that no passenger in the station would have measured
The petrol, meaning the fuel itself and not the ticket
Every sort of petrol in that station
the petrol at the far platform
the petrol was the whole of the matter
the petrol had become a line in a timetable
The petrol of the whole thing

answers.why: save the petrol 意为“省这一升汽油”，1972 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一升汽油做了一遍。
petrol 意为“汽油”，指那升汽油本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。
petrol 意为“汽油”，指车站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
petrol 意为“汽油”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
petrol 意为“汽油、开销”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这升开销就是那件事的全部。
petrol 意为“开销”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那升汽油，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
petrol 意为“汽油”，指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一升，到 1977 年这一升成了时刻表里的一行。
petrol 意为“汽油之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的汽油之事是一处车站和三个日子的测量。
petrol 意为“汽油”，我记得的是时刻表里测量过的那一升，1979 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一升。
petrol 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，汽油是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的汽油。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1972 年那位司机省了车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一升汽油，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（save the petrol）
那升汽油，指的是那升汽油本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。（petrol）
那处车站里每一类汽油旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（petrol）
最远那座站台那升汽油，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（petrol）
叔叔说这升开销就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那升汽油。（petrol）
1981 年母亲说，汽油是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的汽油。（petrol）

Every sort of petrol in that station had the same short ticket beside it.
The petrol at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the petrol was the whole of the matter, meaning the cost and not the fuel.
